name: claude-music
description: Playlist sync and library tidying for Claude Code through your own Nicotine+ (Soulseek) client and MusicBrainz. Everything runs locally.

plugins.name: claude-music
plugins.description: Import playlists from TIDAL, Deezer, YouTube Music or an export file, match them against your local library, fetch the missing tracks through Nicotine+ (Soulseek) with your approval, write an M3U, then tidy the library: tags, duplicates, Artist/Album/NN - Title.
